adjudication.depicted_input: Tissue patch to cell sentences to spatial sentence, i.e. the serialized neighborhood/token sequence supplied to TISSUENARRATOR.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop already shows the route-specific input construction pipeline and the model-visible representation: cells are encoded as cell sentences and assembled into a spatial sentence with position/metadata/gene-list fields. Under the atlas rules, that is sufficient even without a fully visible LLM box, because the depicted serialized spatial sentence is the stated carrier fed to the model for the supported routes. Other candidate figures are mainly downstream analyses or perturbation results and are not visibly better for the core input route.
